definitions.explanation: Suffix attaching to a noun to name an organized exhibition or art/cultural show. Used widely in titles of museum, gallery, and trade-show events.

examples.japanese: ⟦{個|こ}{展|てん}→個展：15068_koten⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|ひら}いた→開く：01979_hiraku⟧。

examples.english: I went to see a painting exhibition.

examples.japanese: ⟦{有名|ゆうめい}→有名：01106_yuumei⟧な⟦{写真|しゃしん}{家|か}→写真家：05501_shashinka⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{回顧|かいこ}→回顧：12022_kaiko⟧{展|てん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{来月|らいげつ}→来月：00744_raigetsu⟧⟦{開催|かいさい}される→開催する：10441_kaisaisuru⟧。
examples.english: A retrospective exhibition by a famous photographer will be held next month.

notes:
A shortened form of ⟦{展覧|てんらん}{会|かい}→展覧会：01470_tenrankai⟧ (exhibition) used as a noun suffix. Most common in art, photography, and design contexts.

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{個|こ}{展|てん}→個展：15068_koten⟧: solo exhibition
- ⟦{絵画|かいが}→絵画：02597_kaiga⟧{展|てん}: painting exhibition
- ⟦{写真|しゃしん}→写真：00753_shashin⟧{展|てん}: photo exhibition
- ⟦{回顧|かいこ}→回顧：12022_kaiko⟧{展|てん}: retrospective exhibition
- ⟦{企画|きかく}→企画：04879_kikaku⟧{展|てん}: special (themed) exhibition
- ⟦{美術|びじゅつ}→美術：04447_bijutsu⟧{展|てん}: art exhibition

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- 〜{展|てん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|ひら}く→開く：01979_hiraku⟧ / ⟦{開催|かいさい}する→開催する：10441_kaisaisuru⟧: to hold an exhibition
- 〜{展|てん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧: to go to an exhibition
